ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity pixel area (approximately 92%) against localized high-intensity pixel clusters at distal tips and along linear abrasions (approximately 8%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-grey/black pigmentation across the primary surface. High-contrast white contiguous clusters are localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips. Scattered high-contrast circular nodes (approx. 10-20 pixels) are visible on the right lobe interior. Linear high-intensity tracks are distributed across the lower and central quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of the total visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary featuring high-frequency serrations. Peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes range from 5 to 35 pixels along the entire visible linear boundary, with significant notches on the outer lateral halves.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a consistent convex sweep from the water line to the distal tips. Trailing edge margins follow a multi-segmented concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-relief clusters of white, circular pixel groups (barnacles) at both distal lobe tips. Individual circular high-contrast nodes are detected on the interior surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned linear white pixel tracks (rake marks) ranging from 40 to 400 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial barnacle colonization at the lateral terminal tips; multiple linear rake marks across the ventral surface; several circular scars localized on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized heavy concentration of calcified organisms creating a high-contrast, textured white border exclusively at the lateral-most points of both lobes.
